source: Decision Desk HQ API v4, races endpoint
nationalVoteMethod: Sum published topline candidate votes by DDHQ party across the 435 voting districts. Denominator includes all parties. No two-party normalization, missing-vote imputation, uncontested-race adjustment, or separate RCV-round substitution. Preliminary reported votes, not final national popular vote.
houseControlMethod: Derived from DDHQ-called district winners: at least 218 called seats. This is not a separately retrieved DDHQ chamber call.

results.notes: DDHQ; 435 voting districts, DC excluded. Partial reported vote; 3 districts have no votes reported. Seats are called winners; 2 LA runoffs unresolved. Control derived from called seats; direct chamber feed unavailable. Timestamp: Eastern.
